name: Tangled Pasta: Angel Hair in Basil Pesto with Pan-Seared Sea Scallops (Lantern Night)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table (Lantern Night)
whyItWorks: Tender pan-seared sea scallops over delicate refined angel hair pasta; aged Parmesan in pesto is naturally lactose-free.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for light basil pesto (or plain olive oil/butter if garlic in pesto triggers FODMAP symptoms) and skip the roasted cherry tomato garnish.
watchOuts: Garlic and olive oil richness in basil pesto
